versions.subject: Windows Redcannary
versions.detection:
selection_cmdlet:
    ScriptBlockText|contains:
        - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
        - 'iwr '
selection_method:
    ScriptBlockText|contains: '-Method '
selection_verb:
        - ' Put ' 
        - ' Post '
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: ScriptBlockText IN ("*Invoke-WebRequest*", "*iwr *") ScriptBlockText="*-Method *" " Put " OR " Post "

versions.subject: Merge PR #5534 from @swachchhanda000 - update PowerShell WebRequest rules
versions.detection:
selection_cmdlet:
    ScriptBlockText|contains:
        - 'Invoke-RestMethod'
        - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
        - 'irm '
        - 'iwr '
selection_flag:
    ScriptBlockText|contains:
        - '-Method "POST"'
        - '-Method "PUT"'
        - '-Method POST'
        - '-Method PUT'
        - "-Method 'POST'"
        - "-Method 'PUT'"
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: ScriptBlockText IN ("*Invoke-RestMethod*", "*Invoke-WebRequest*", "*irm *", "*iwr *") ScriptBlockText IN ("*-Method \"POST\"*", "*-Method \"PUT\"*", "*-Method POST*", "*-Method PUT*", "*-Method 'POST'*", "*-Method 'PUT'*")
